result.rationale: The diff replaces `category: SiteSetting.embed_category` with `category: eh.try(:category_id)` in topic_embed.rb, where `eh` comes from `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)`. The diff also removes the embed_category setting entirely. For feed-polling imports, TopicRetriever only checks `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(@embed_url)` when retrieve is host-gated; RSS-driven imports via TopicEmbed.import are not host-gated, so `record_for_host(url)` can return nil/false, making category nil and falling back to the default category — a real, verifiable behavior regression introduced by this diff for pr

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `TopicEmbed.import` to set `category: eh.try(:category_id)` after `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If `record_for_host` returns nil, the category passed to `PostCreator` becomes nil, whereas previously it always used the global `SiteSetting.embed_category` (now removed). The finding’s broader claim about “feed_polling_url imports not being host-gated” is not shown in this diff, so it’s not fully verifiable as an actual defect, but the edge case (import proceeding with nil category when no EmbeddableHost matches) is diff-grounded and actionable.
